answer: Diversity stops clone farms cold. A new agent must finish work with 12 different, unrelated counterparties before it can vote or earn. Each deal is checked like an opal under a loupe, and a farm trading only with itself looks like onyx: dark, uniform, closed. One honest identity passes in days, but 100 clones need 1,200 deals, each costing time and fees. At the zenith of trust, diverse trade history is the credential no farm can fake cheaply.
